newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Jan-Aug financial sector profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Chile Jan-Aug financial sector profits rise.

text.p: Chile's financial system reported net profits of 148.6 billion pesos in the eight months to August, up 6.5 percent on the same period last year, said Superintendency of Banks and Financial Institutions.
The superintendency's figures showed last month's earnings were 9.6 percent higher than in July.
Total loan portfolios grew 13.4 percent with credits to companies increasing 16 percent, mortgages up 23 percent and consumer loans growing 31 percent on the same period last year.

Banco de Chile reported the highest profits among local private banks with net earnings to August of 16.06 billion pesos. Comparative figures for the same month last year were not immediately available.

It was followed in turn by Banco de Credito e Inversiones with net earnings of 14.58 billion pesos, Banco O'Higgins at 14.06 billion pesos and Banco de A Edwards with net profits of 12.22 billion pesos.
Banco de Santiago reported net earnings of 9.08 billion pesos with Banco Bhif posting profits of 8.07 billion pesos.
Banco Santander-Chile, Chile's largest foreign-owned bank, reported net earnings of 21.37 billion pesos in the eight months to August.
